diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index ef1c054..bd336ac 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,20 @@
+openjdk-lts (11.0.25+9-1ubuntu1) oracular; urgency=medium
+
+  * OpenJDK 11.0.25 release, build 9.
+
+     - CVEs
+       + CVE-2024-21208, 8328286: Enhance HTTP client
+       + CVE-2024-21210, 8328544: Improve handling of vectorization
+       + CVE-2024-21217, 8331446: Improve deserialization support
+       + CVE-2024-21235, 8332644: Improve graph optimizations
+
+  [ Vladimir Petko ]
+  * d/rules: do not include dtrace support for S390x (JDK-8305174).
+  * d/t/problems.csv: Disable jdk/sun/security/util/Debug/DebugOptions.java
+    due to JDK-8339713.
+
+ -- Pushkar Kulkarni <pushkar.kulkarni@canonical.com>  Thu, 17 Oct 2024 22:51:26 +0530
+
 openjdk-lts (11.0.25~5ea-1ubuntu1) oracular; urgency=medium
 
   * OpenJDK 11.0.25+5 build (early access) (LP: #2080298).

@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@ Build-Depends: debhelper (>= 11),

diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index f569509..ab686c8 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -79,7 +79,6 @@ else
 endif
 
 is_upstream_release = yes
-is_upstream_release =
 
 srcdir		= .
 builddir	= build
@@ -407,12 +406,16 @@ else ifeq ($(with_nss),no)
   CONFIGURE_ARGS += --disable-nss
 endif
 
-CONFIGURE_ARGS += --enable-dtrace
-
 COMMON_CONFIGURE_ARGS =
 DEFAULT_CONFIGURE_ARGS =
 ZERO_CONFIGURE_ARGS =
 
+# S390x does not support dtrace probes
+# https://github.com/openjdk/jdk/pull/13228
+ifeq (,$(filter $(DEB_HOST_ARCH), powerpc ppc64 ppc64el s390x))
+  CONFIGURE_ARGS += --enable-dtrace
+endif
+
 # FIXME: --with-jvm-variants=server,zero not supported upstream
 ifneq (,$(filter $(DEB_HOST_ARCH),$(hotspot_archs)))
   ifneq (,$(filter $(DEB_HOST_ARCH),i386))
@@ -699,7 +702,7 @@ ifeq ($(with_nss),yes)
     bd_nss = libnss3-dev (>= 2:3.17.1),
   endif
 endif
-bd_systemtap = systemtap-sdt-dev [!sh4],
+bd_systemtap = systemtap-sdt-dev [!powerpc !ppc64 !ppc64el !sh4 !s390x],
 
 ifeq (,$(filter $(distrel),jessie stretch buster precise trusty xenial bionic focal groovy))
   with_debugedit = yes
@@ -1935,7 +1938,7 @@ endif
 	dh_builddeb -a $(nodemo) $(nojrez) #$(bd_options)
 
 git_project		= jdk11u
-git_tag			= jdk-11.0.25+5
+git_tag			= jdk-11.0.25+9
 package_version		= $(subst jdk-,,$(git_tag))
 package_version		= $(shell echo $(PKGVERSION) | sed 's/-[^-][^-]*$$//')
 ifneq ($(is_upstream_release),yes)
